asset.name: Lido DAO

score_rationales.supply: LDO is capped at 1 billion tokens with about 85% circulating (CoinGecko), and scheduled unlocks largely finished by February 2024 (Tokenomics.com), so mechanical vesting overhang is mostly behind while further supply pressure is mainly discretionary DAO treasury use rather than fixed inflation (help.lido.fi). Exchange-side liquidity is mixed: analytics outlets have reported sustained withdrawals from exchanges and committee-led removals from Binance, but large one-off whale deposits to CEXs still appear and add tactical sell-side risk. Holder metrics cited by Kaiko’s LDO asset-metrics work show the retail/long-tail slice growing sharply while the Lido treasury balance fell as incentives were paid, though governance-oriented float means most supply is not economically locked like a native staking chain token.
score_rationales.wyckoff: Wyckoff phase carried from last snapshot until the next daily indicators refresh.
score_rationales.adoption_activity: DefiLlama lists Lido at roughly $18.3B TVL and ~9.2M ETH staked—far ahead of other Ethereum liquid staking protocols—with stETH wired into major lending and DEX liquidity venues; the broader LST sector shows slight near-term TVL softness (~−0.2% 7d / ~−2.5% 30d on aggregate LST metrics), so usage is dominant but no longer in a strong growth phase.
score_rationales.value_capture: Daily revenue: $152K (~$55.4M/year). TVL: $20.96B. Revenue/TVL ratio: 0.26%. Daily fees: $1.5M.
